_comment: Installer return codes for AmF X1, as set by install/windows/amfx1.nsi (setup.exe) and documented in docs/msi.md (MSI). Feeds deploy/website/install-help.html via scripts/build-website.js. English only.
exe: AmF X1 is installed. Nothing to do.
Setup was closed before it finished. Run setup.exe again and let it complete.
Run setup.exe again as administrator (right-click, Run as administrator). If it fails again, re-download the installer from this site and check whether your antivirus quarantined any AmF X1 file.
Free space on the system drive (C:) and run setup again.
Another AmF X1 setup is already running
Close the other AmF X1 setup window (or wait for it to finish), then run setup again.
Restart Windows to finish the installation (the audio driver is loaded after the restart).
msi: AmF X1 is installed. Nothing to do.
The installation was cancelled. Run it again and let it complete.
Run the MSI again from an administrator command prompt with a log (see below). Re-download the MSI if the file may be damaged and check your antivirus quarantine.
Windows allows one installer at a time. Wait for the other installation (often Windows Update) to finish, or restart Windows, then try again.
Uninstall the existing AmF X1 from Settings, Apps, Installed apps, then install again.
AmF X1 is installed; restart Windows to finish.
Free space on the system drive (C:) and try again.
